what_happened.line: The Select Board spent most of the evening on a facilities workshop covering Town Hall, the Ritter building, Brooks House, the old primary school and TCP; no budget vote was taken.
The board agreed to aim for a December 2 walking tour and a December 7 charette on town buildings.
The board reviewed special Town Meeting articles: an FY18 budget adjustment and a transfer of an unspent balance for conceptual design of municipal offices.
The board voted to accept road-cut fee schedules as proposed; the minutes record the vote as not audible.
The board approved a liquor license transfer and a peddlers license, and made several appointments; the vote tallies were not audible.

why_it_matters: Where town offices end up, and whether Town Hall and other old buildings are repaired or replaced, will shape future capital requests that residents vote on at Town Meeting and pay for through taxes.
The special Town Meeting articles would move money between town accounts, and the road-cut fees set what utilities and contractors pay to dig up town roads.
watch_next: December 2 walking tour of town buildings and December 7 charette, as the board agreed to aim for.
The special Town Meeting vote on the FY18 budget adjustment and the municipal office conceptual design transfer.
